blocks.text: The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has issued 1,200 special permits for provincial buses nationwide ahead of the expected increase in passenger traffic during the All Saints’ Day holiday, Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Giovanni Lopez said on Monday.
